name: Verify DYNAMIC TABLE maps displayed headers and FLEX TABLE excludes its header row

steps.name: $("open") http://nginx:80/table/delayed-table.html
$("webdriver") create()
$("#customers/By.xpath: (.//tr)[position() > 1].findBy(row with 'Ernst Handel' in 'COMPANY' column)") should be([exist, 5s])
$("table row candidate/By.xpath: ./td[1]") has(exact text case sensitive "Ernst Handel")

$("#customers") should be(visible)
$("#customers/By.xpath: (.//tr)[position() > 1].findBy(row with 'Ernst Handel' in 'COMPANY' column)/By.xpath: ./td[3]") get text()
$("table row candidate/By.xpath: ./td[1]") has(exact text case sensitive "Ernst Handel")
$("table row candidate/By.xpath: ./td[1]") has(exact text case sensitive "Ernst Handel")

$("#flex-customers/By.xpath: (.//*[contains(concat(' ', normalize-space(@class), ' '), ' flex-table-row ')])[position() > 1].findBy(row with 'Ernst Handel' in 'COMPANY' column)") should be([exist, 5s])
$("table row candidate/By.xpath: ./div[1]") has(exact text case sensitive "Ernst Handel")
$("table row candidate/By.xpath: ./div[1]") has(exact text case sensitive "Ernst Handel")

$("#flex-customers/By.xpath: (.//*[contains(concat(' ', normalize-space(@class), ' '), ' flex-table-row ')])[position() > 1].findBy(row with 'Ernst Handel' in 'COMPANY' column)/By.xpath: ./div[3]") get text()

$("table row candidate/By.xpath: ./div[1]") has(exact text case sensitive "Ernst Handel")
$("#flex-customers/By.xpath: (.//*[contains(concat(' ', normalize-space(@class), ' '), ' flex-table-row ')])[position() > 1].findBy(row with 'Company' in 'COMPANY' column)") should be([exist, 600ms])
